weight_sensitivity.reachability_draws_note: 200000 draws from Dirichlet(1) plus 200000 from Dirichlet(0.3); a sample, so the never-winner count is an upper bound on the points no weights can reach. Points with the same cost vector tie and share one count.

epsilon_constraint.sweep_of: Engine size (L) >= bound, other bounds fixed

lexicographic.tolerance_note: a criterion keeps every candidate within the tolerance (in normalised units, 0 = best, 1 = worst) of the best one

criteria_rationale.Combined (L/100 km): minimise: fuel cost and the proxy for CO2, the stand-in for the class Price and FuelEfficiency
criteria_rationale.Engine size (L): maximise: proxy for power, towing and cabin refinement (no power rating exists in the file); it conflicts with fuel
criteria_rationale.Smog rating: maximise: higher is cleaner for local air pollutants (NOx, particulates); only partly aligned with fuel
criteria_rationale.excluded: CO2 g/km and CO2 rating (correlation with combined fuel about 0.99 in magnitude, they would add no conflict); highway and city fuel (components of combined); cylinders (collinear with engine size)

segment.rule: assessed value <= 750000 CAD, lot <= 4000 m2, built 1900 or later, floor area 60-400 m2
segment.why: a buyer's segment; without it a few mansions and rural lots stretch the min-max scale so the other houses crowd near 0

criteria_rationale.value: minimise: the stand-in for price; assessed value is not an asking price
criteria_rationale.floor_m2: maximise: gross floor area of the main building (includes attic and integrated garage in the roll's definition)
criteria_rationale.year_built: maximise: newer construction means less deferred maintenance; the roll gives the original build year, renovations are invisible
criteria_rationale.lot_m2: maximise: more garden, parking and room to extend, at the cost of upkeep; larger is not always better, which is why it carries the lowest weight
criteria_rationale.excluded: number of storeys (a design choice, not a quality); land value and building value (components of value); location, which the roll gives only as a neighbourhood code
